members.name: errorMessage
members.doc: Shown only while the field is invalid, through the invalid prop or failed validation, and replaces the built-in message; it never makes the field invalid by itself.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables the trigger and every option. A Select.Trigger or Select.Item's own `disabled={false}` cannot re-enable them under a disabled Select.

members.name: readOnly
members.doc: Makes the Select read-only: it keeps its value, and `onChange` is not called when an option is chosen.

members.name: required
members.doc: Marks the field required.

members.name: invalid
members.doc: Marks the field invalid and shows its error message. Left false, validation decides, so failed validation can still make the field invalid.

members.name: size
members.doc: The control size. The popup and its options take it too.

members.name: items
members.doc: The options as data: strings, or items with an `id`, a `label`, a `textValue`, and `disabled`. Children take precedence: when both are supplied, the items are not rendered.

members.name: value
members.doc: The id of the selected item, when the caller controls it. A named Select submits this id, not the item's `value`.

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: The id of the item selected at first, when the Select controls itself.

members.name: open
members.doc: Whether the popup is open, when the caller controls it. A disabled Select is closed whatever this says.

members.name: defaultOpen
members.doc: Whether the popup starts open, when the Select controls itself. A disabled Select starts closed.

members.name: name
members.doc: The form field name. A named Select submits the selected item's id, not the item's `value`.

members.name: placeholder
members.doc: The text the default trigger shows while nothing is selected.

members.name: children
members.doc: Composes the field from Select parts in place of the default trigger, popup, and list; the simple `items`, `selectedContent`, and `trigger` are then not rendered. The `label`, `description`, and `errorMessage` still render.

members.name: selectedContent
members.doc: Content the default trigger shows in place of the selected item's text.

members.name: trigger
members.doc: A native button element that replaces the default trigger, keeping its ref, attributes, and handlers. A Select that is disabled disables it. Any other element throws a TypeError.

members.name: placement
members.doc: Where the popup opens against its trigger or anchorRef. start and end follow the locale direction. A Select.Popup's own placement wins over this.

members.name: offset
members.doc: The distance in pixels between the popup and its trigger, along the placement's side. Must be finite. A Select.Popup's own offset wins over this.

members.name: crossOffset
members.doc: The shift in pixels along the side the popup is placed against. Must be finite. A Select.Popup's own crossOffset wins over this.

members.name: shouldFlip
members.doc: Whether the popup moves to the opposite side when the placed side has no room. A Select.Popup's own shouldFlip wins over this.

members.name: containerPadding
members.doc: The least distance in pixels between the popup and the edge of the viewport. Must be finite and not negative. A Select.Popup's own containerPadding wins over this.

members.name: modal
members.doc: Whether the rest of the page is made inaccessible while the popup is open. When false, outside content stays accessible. A Select.Popup's own modal wins over this.

members.name: onChange
members.doc: Called with the id of the chosen item, or with no value when the selection clears. It is not called while the Select is disabled or read-only.

members.name: onOpenChange
members.doc: Called with the next open state when the popup opens or closes. It is not called for a request to open a disabled Select.
